Prophecy: The Great Commission to All Nations
ProphecySummary: The risen Jesus commissions his disciples to teach all nations, baptizing them and teaching them to observe all he commanded, with his promise that he is with them always, even unto the end of the world.
Fulfillment: Partially fulfilled: the gospel has been preached among all nations and Christ's promised presence has accompanied the church, while the task is not yet complete and the end of the world has not yet come. Note: Mark 16:15 stands in the disputed longer ending of Mark (see the signs draft).
